description: Native Windows client for browsing and playing movies and TV shows from a personal Feiniu Video server.
notes: Requires access to a Feiniu Video server and an account authorized to view its media libraries. The portable archive includes the app, libmpv runtime files and third-party license notices.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter '*.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'FNMovie executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'FNMovie.exe'
